scope: Nine unique official sources selected for 24 cleared builds
truthBoundary: All nine URLs returned exact parseable source bytes. Six HTML response bodies are preserved byte-identically as inert .html.source.txt files and may be treated as staged source material only. Three PDFs remain absent because large base64 transfer changed their Git blob hashes. Preserved source is not an approved crop, rendered visual, live-cover substitution or Canva asset.

verificationRules: HTTP GET completed without an error response.
Container signature was checked locally; HTML was parsed as UTF-8 and PDFs identified as PDFs.
SHA-256 and byte length were computed from the fetched response body.
PDF page count and page size were read with pdfinfo.
A URL, hash or temporary fetch is not a staged repository binary.
For preserved HTML, the Git blob SHA equals local `git hash-object` for the fetched bytes.
Executable .html paths are forbidden; preserved HTML snapshots must end in .html.source.txt.
